mapper.select: SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_id, uc.status, uc.claim_time, uc.use_time, ct.name AS couponName, ct.type AS couponType, ct.discount_amount, ct.discount_rate, ct.min_order_amount, ct.start_time, ct.end_time FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon_template ct ON uc.coupon_id = ct.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.claim_time DESC
